description:
Would you like to innovate on the most visible and persistent experience on Amazon's websites and apps, one that reaches every customer who visits and supports partner teams across the company? Would you like to build low latency, highly resilient distributed systems at scale, and deliver world class customer experiences across every device? If so, the Navigation Experiences (NavX) team has an opportunity for you.

NavX serves tens of thousands of transactions per second and billions of views per day. Our footprint is large and visible, and the systems behind it have to be fast, reliable, and easy for partners to build on.

The role
As a full stack Software Development Engineer on NavX, you will design, build, and operate both the backend services and the customer facing experiences that make up navigation across Amazon. You will own features and components end to end, from data model and service to the rendered experience on app, mobile web, and desktop. You will ship code daily through continuous deployment pipelines in an agile environment, and you will optimize our systems for scale, latency, and resilience.

You will work closely with other engineers, product managers, and partner teams, and you will take technical ambiguity and turn it into concrete, well scoped designs. You will raise the engineering bar on the team through code reviews, operational excellence, and mentoring, and you will keep looking around the corner for ways to improve the architecture and the customer experience.

What you will work on
We own navigation across all devices on the Amazon retail experience. That includes browsing destinations in the Hamburger menu, shopping within Store Modes, finding account and personalized content in the You Tab, and discovering strategic programs through the Strategic Subnav and Discovery Bar. We own the navigation chrome on all rendering platforms, along with the platform aspects of its flyouts and tooltips. To support builders across Amazon, we also own Nav Config Studio, which lets partner teams specify navigation links and hierarchies through our experiences.

Our mission is to serve as an indispensable guide that helps customers find what they need, whenever and wherever they need it, and to get out of the way when they do not need our help. Our vision is a tailored navigation experience that brings forward the most important and relevant information for a customer at any stage of their shopping journey.






Key job responsibilities
You have strong technical design, problem solving, and communication skills, and you are comfortable working with technical and non technical stakeholders. You have experience building and operating production cloud services, and you understand how to design for scalability, performance, and reliability. You are a full stack engineer who is as comfortable in a service and data layer as in the client code that renders a customer experience. You want to learn new skills and take on problems that have not been solved before, and you work backwards from the customer.

About the team
We are a diverse, intellectually curious team that likes to have fun and accomplish big things. We care about engineering excellence, operational ownership, and a customer experience we are proud of.
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
